findings.title: Reset the season in Season setup does nothing: the window closes and the reset never opens
findings.what_happens: The press sets resetAsked and calls dialog.close(). A DialogV2 closed with rejectClose: false answers null, so result is null; line 1214 returns null on '!result' before line 1215 reads resetAsked. End the chapter, built the same way beside it, works only because its flag is read first (1213). Since E101 this frame is Reset the season's one door: the GM panel's tile went in E49 A1d (gm-panel.mjs:305-308), and no game.drpg entry or other caller of resetSeason exists (git grep: season-setup.mjs:1215 is the only call outside season-wipe.mjs).
findings.failure_scenario: A GM ending a season opens Season setup and presses Reset the season: the window closes, nothing else opens and nothing is said, and no other button in the module starts a reset.
findings.expected: the reset's flag read before the null answer, as End the chapter's is, so the press opens season-wipe.mjs resetSeason
findings.refutation_tried: Looked for another answer of the close: drpgWindow returns DialogV2.wait(config) (ui-kit.mjs:1344), and rejectClose: false is passed (:1210), so a close() answers null; the footer has no 'reset' action since E101 (R4055 asserts its absence). Looked for another door: gm-panel.mjs has no seasonReset tile (R3582's 'tiles: [false, ...]'), api.mjs names no resetSeason, chapter.mjs:826 only mentions it in a comment. Looked for a test that presses it: R4055 (tests-tier1.mjs:20336-20354) and the test at tests-tier1.mjs:20694 match the source line 'if (resetAsked) return ...' by regular expression and press nothing; the tier 2 tests that drive openSeasonSetup (E49-A1e, E101-T10, E101-T11, the End the chapter press at tests-tier2.mjs:99458) do not press Reset. The order came in 59e1997a (r112 review P2, P4), the first commit holding 'if (resetAsked)'. base-run.json is not present, so no result is cited.
findings.probe: As a GM: await game.drpg... openSeasonSetup() (season-setup.mjs), press [data-drpg-reset-season], then read whether any window with the class drpg-window-season-reset is in foundry.applications.instances (expected one; read: none)

findings.title: Season setup's Save writes the clock's six fields and the safeword as they were when the window opened: a time step, a trial started or another GM's change since is undone without a question
findings.control: Save (with Edit campaign's six fields and the safeword)
findings.where: scripts/season-setup.mjs:1134, 1161 (drawn once), 1179 (read), 1250, 1255-1258 (written); scripts/gm-campaign.mjs:347-361 (the patch of all six)
findings.what_happens: The fields are drawn from getClock() and the safeword setting once, and the window has no live region or hook. Save hands every field to applyCampaignForm, which builds a patch of campaignName, chapter, day, phase, session and timeOfDay from the form and writes it through setClock; only a chapter change and an entry into the Class Trial ask first (gm-campaign.mjs:308-334). So a time of day or a day stepped on the HUD or the GM panel while Season setup stood open is set back (and correctsTheHour, :357, then calls off an assembly), and a Class Trial started from the trial console meanwhile is left by the phase select still reading Investigation - clock.mjs reconcilePhase:999-1034 then ends the floor, shuts the vote uncounted and runs the sentence's exit. The safeword is written when the drawn value differs from the setting as it stands, so another GM's new word is put back. The comment at gm-campaign.mjs:281-286 says the Eclipse warning compares against the clock at the write because 'it is not a live window'; the write itself does not.

findings.title: Both settings windows draw every setting once and their Save writes a stale row back over a change made elsewhere while they stood open
findings.surface: This browser's settings; The game's settings
findings.where: scripts/settings-window.mjs:186-209 (a row's value read at open), 408-437 (saveSettings), 445-523 (no listener)
